Players Committee errata card image of [[Captain Lennox (PC Errata 2018 E card)]], marked "E", as it stood in the [[Holotable]] image set when the PC's GitHub repository [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable swccgpc/holotable] was first committed on 8 July 2018 (commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b]). The PC later replaced it with a "D-E1" image, [[Captain Lennox (PC 2022 D-E1 card)]] (commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/4dee9a17f7f3e71ba2ae86dc733ede5dd9d5c9ef 4dee9a1], 23 December 2022).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Hoth-Dark/large/captainlennox.gif</code> at commit 022435b ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/tree/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Hoth-Dark/large folder listing]). Uploaded unchanged. SHA-256 <code>0ee4a0429a2206954645f5e8860bb0f8e7063387cfea9188246bbcfe2c1f048b</code>.

The card image may be older than 8 July 2018: that is the date of the repository's first commit, which imported the existing image set.

Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
